takes.title: Backward somersault from a squat
takes.actionDescription: The performer lowers from standing into a hand-assisted squat, rolls backward in a tuck, and pushes back up to standing.

takes.title: Cartwheel from an open-arm stance
takes.actionDescription: The performer holds both arms out, reaches down to swing the legs overhead into a split, then lands and reopens the arms.

takes.title: Cartwheel with a wide setup
takes.actionDescription: The performer waits with feet and arms spread, tilts sideways to put a hand down and bring the legs over, and returns to the starting stance.

takes.title: Cartwheel from an Arms-Out Stance
takes.actionDescription: The performer begins with feet apart and arms extended, tips sideways onto the hands, and passes through an inverted split. They return to an open standing stance with the arms extended.

takes.title: Jump kick with high leg extension
takes.actionDescription: The performer takes quick approach steps, swings one leg up into a high kick with the arms spread, then steps through the landing.

takes.title: Jump kick with both arms lifted
takes.actionDescription: The performer waits in a wide stance, steps into a jump kick with a high leg and both arms raised, then turns out of the landing.

takes.title: Jump kick with a forward-leaning exit
takes.actionDescription: The performer pauses in a wide stance, steps into the kick, then pitches forward with one arm reaching down and steps upright.

takes.title: Side flip into a crouched landing
takes.actionDescription: The performer dips from standing, lifts off into a sideways tucked turnover, then lands low and straightens.

takes.title: Forward inversion onto both hands
takes.actionDescription: The performer sets the arms, kicks into a near-vertical hand-supported position, then brings the feet back down and stands.

takes.title: Handspring into a step-out
takes.actionDescription: The performer enters quickly, passes through a split-leg inversion on both hands, springs back to the feet, and steadies with the arms open.

takes.title: Twisting backflip ending flat on the back
takes.actionDescription: The performer raises both arms, jumps into a twisting backward turnover, drops onto the back, and stays down.

takes.title: Twisting backflip with a sideways floor recovery
takes.actionDescription: The performer raises the arms, arches and rotates backward in the air, then lands on the floor and shifts through several low positions.

takes.title: Forward handspring into an overhead finish
takes.actionDescription: The performer raises both arms, folds forward onto the hands, comes back onto the feet with bent knees, and holds both arms overhead.

takes.title: Forward handspring and walk away
takes.actionDescription: The performer holds both arms overhead, turns over through a two-hand support, lands with the arms raised again, and steps away at the end.

takes.title: Forward fall to a prone hold
takes.actionDescription: The performer crouches, pitches forward with the body extended, descends toward the floor, and remains face down.

takes.title: Slip backward with legs in the air
takes.actionDescription: The performer walks into a slip, flings the arms out and falls backward with both feet swinging up. The matching 90_17 source labels it a banana-peel slip.

takes.title: Sudden fall onto the back
takes.actionDescription: The performer drops abruptly from standing, passes through a seated position with the legs out, and rolls flat on the back. The matching 90_18 source calls it a rug-pull fall.

takes.title: Monkey-style backflip and low balance
takes.actionDescription: The performer lowers toward all fours, turns backward through a hand-supported position, and ends low with one leg extended. The matching 90_19 source calls it a monkey backflip.

takes.title: Monkey-style floor sequence with a jump
takes.actionDescription: The performer folds close to the floor and alternates low hand-supported travel with a wide jump and raised arms, ending in a compact floor pose.

takes.title: Monkey-style leaps and low floor travel
takes.actionDescription: The performer folds onto hands and feet, springs up with the legs and arms spread, then moves through low hand-supported positions and finishes close to the floor.

takes.title: Short straight walk
takes.actionDescription: The performer walks straight ahead with alternating steps and relaxed arm swings, continuing at a steady pace through the take.

takes.title: Longer straight walk
takes.actionDescription: The performer keeps a steady line and relaxed arms through a series of even walking strides.

takes.title: High step onto a ball mime
takes.actionDescription: The performer pauses upright, raises one knee sharply with bent arms out for balance, then steadies with the arms lowered. The matching 90_24 source describes mounting a ball.

takes.title: Forward ball walk with a low catch
takes.actionDescription: The performer steps forward with a quiet upper body before swinging one arm overhead, pitching forward, and catching balance in a crouch. The matching 90_25 source describes walking on a ball.

takes.title: Forward ball walk with open-arm corrections
takes.actionDescription: The performer takes small steps with soft knees, opens the arms to either side for balance, and comes upright. The matching 90_26 source describes walking forward on a ball.

takes.title: Backward ball walk
takes.actionDescription: The performer makes short backward steps, letting the arms drift out as the torso sways, then returns to a steadier upright posture. The matching 90_27 source describes walking on a ball.

takes.title: Breakdance drop and floor roll
takes.actionDescription: The performer crouches with the arms open, rolls back and lifts the legs into a wide split, then rocks through several tucked positions and finishes sitting low.

takes.title: Tumbling phrase with turns
takes.actionDescription: The performer moves from standing through several hand-supported inversions with changing leg shapes, rises into upright turns and steps, and ends with both arms open.

takes.title: Squat dance with alternating low kicks
takes.actionDescription: The performer lowers into a deep squat, alternates forward leg extensions with both arms held out for balance, then rises to stand.

takes.title: Squat kicks with overhead arm accents
takes.actionDescription: The performer drops into a low squat, kicks the feet out in turn while changing arm positions overhead, and springs back up to standing.

takes.title: Moonwalk with a bent-arm finish
takes.actionDescription: The performer shifts between planted and sliding feet with lifted heels, keeping the upper body upright and one arm bent near the hip as the glide continues.

takes.title: Wide-leg roll with one arm up
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts wide with one arm overhead, folds to the floor for a roll with the legs spread, and rises back into the raised-arm stance.

takes.title: Compact roll from standing
takes.actionDescription: The performer folds down from narrow standing, rolls through a compact tuck, then balances briefly low on the feet before standing again.

takes.title: Wide-leg roll into a seated split
takes.actionDescription: The performer widens the feet, puts both hands down and turns over, passes through a seated straddle, then recovers to a wide standing stance.

takes.title: Wide-leg roll with arm sweep finish
takes.actionDescription: The performer bends forward from a wide stance, rolls through an inverted straddle into a low split, and stands wide with one arm extending out.
